    Device uintptr
    Queue uintptr
    SwapChain uintptr
}

type GLESHandles struct {
    EGLDisplay uintptr
    EGLContext uintptr
    EGLConfig uintptr
    EGLSurface uintptr
    HGLRC uintptr
    HDC uintptr
}

type Handles struct {
    Kind BackendKind
    Vulkan VulkanHandles
    DX12 DX12Handles
    Metal MetalHandles
    GLES GLESHandles
    WebGPU WebGPUHandles
}

const KindBrowser BackendKind = 5

const KindDX12 BackendKind = 3

const KindGLES BackendKind = 4

const KindMetal BackendKind = 2

const KindNoop BackendKind = 7

const KindSoftware BackendKind = 6

const KindUnknown BackendKind = 0

const KindVulkan BackendKind = 1

const KindWebGPU BackendKind = 8

type MetalHandles struct {
    Device uintptr
    CommandQueue uintptr
    Layer uintptr
}

type VulkanHandles struct {
    Instance uintptr
    PhysicalDevice uintptr
    Device uintptr
    Queue uintptr
    QueueFamilyIndex uint32
    GetInstanceProcAddr uintptr
    GetDeviceProcAddr uintptr
    Surface uintptr
}

type WebGPUHandles struct {
    Instance uintptr
    Adapter uintptr
    Device uintptr
    Queue uintptr
}

package github.com/gogpu/wgpu/wgputest

type BindGroupBind struct {
    Seq uint64
    Pass int
    Index uint32
    DynamicOffsets []uint32
}

type BufferCreate struct {
    Seq uint64
    Label string
    Size uint64
    Usage github.com/gogpu/gputypes.BufferUsage
}

type Counts struct {
    Encoders int
    Buffers int
    Textures int
    TextureViews int
    VertexBuffers int
    IndexBuffers int
    BindGroups int
    Passes int
    Draws int
    DrawsIndexed int
    Submits int
}

type Draw struct {
    Seq uint64
    Pass int
    VertexCount uint32
    InstanceCount uint32
    FirstVertex uint32
    FirstInstance uint32
}

type DrawIndexed struct {
    Seq uint64
    Pass int
    IndexCount uint32
    InstanceCount uint32
    FirstIndex uint32
    BaseVertex int32
    FirstInstance uint32
}

type EncoderCreate struct {
    Seq uint64
    Index int
    Label string
}

var ErrUnavailable error

type Faults struct {
    CreateCommandEncoder error
    WriteBuffer error
}

type IndexBufferBind struct {
    Seq uint64
    Pass int
    Label string
    Format github.com/gogpu/gputypes.IndexFormat
    Offset uint64
    Size uint64
}

func NewDetachedTexture(desc *github.com/gogpu/wgpu.TextureDescriptor) *github.com/gogpu/wgpu.Texture

func NewNoopDevice(opts ...Option) (*github.com/gogpu/wgpu.Device, *github.com/gogpu/wgpu.Queue, func(), error)

func NewRecorder() *Recorder

func NewSoftwareDevice(opts ...Option) (*github.com/gogpu/wgpu.Device, *github.com/gogpu/wgpu.Queue, func(), error)

type Option func(*config)

type PassBegin struct {
    Seq uint64
    Index int
    Encoder int
    Compute bool
    Label string
    LoadOps []github.com/gogpu/gputypes.LoadOp
    Clears []github.com/gogpu/gputypes.Color
}

type Recorder struct {
}
method (*Recorder) Counts() Counts
method (*Recorder) Reset()
method (*Recorder) Trace() Trace

type Submit struct {
    Seq uint64
    SubmissionIndex uint64
    CommandBuffers int
}

type TextureCreate struct {
    Seq uint64
    Label string
}

type TextureViewCreate struct {
    Seq uint64
    Label string
}

type Trace struct {
    Encoders []EncoderCreate
    Buffers []BufferCreate
    Textures []TextureCreate
    TextureViews []TextureViewCreate
    VertexBuffers []VertexBufferBind
    IndexBuffers []IndexBufferBind
    BindGroups []BindGroupBind
    Passes []PassBegin
    Draws []Draw
    DrawsIndexed []DrawIndexed
    Submits []Submit
}

type VertexBufferBind struct {
    Seq uint64
    Pass int
    Slot uint32
    Label string
    Offset uint64
    Size uint64
}

func WithFaults(f Faults) Option

func WithRecorder(r *Recorder) Option
